purpose: Versioned source admission only; no developmental result follows from this gate.
source_authority: Immutable Git tree including every tracked path, mode, object identity, original regular bytes, raw symbolic-link target and opaque gitlink pointer.
supported_extension: Safe internal file symbolic links, materialized as original symbolic links and independently checked before and after execution. Original metadata, static suite authority, collection, assertion, import, plugin and receipt-replay algorithms remain authoritative.
unsupported: Missing or uninitialized gitlink contents: UNKNOWN_UNINITIALIZED_GITLINK; inventory never authorizes fetching or installed substitution
Escaping, absolute, dangling, cyclic or Git-administration symbolic links
Unclosed conditional dependency and dynamic metadata grammars retain their earlier UNKNOWN status
positive_controls: Regular source behavior and executable bit survive source transport
Internal file symbolic link preserves raw target and actual filesystem semantics
Native import through an internal file symbolic link authenticates the canonical tracked target
Malformed Python used only as data is inventoried without parser authority
Complete original protected tests execute nonzero calls with independent recollection and native receipt replay
Protected assertion failure is independently observed as FAIL_NATIVE
negative_controls: Wrong raw link target with equal resolved bytes
Source kind, mode, bytes or pointer mutation
Absolute, escaping, dangling, cyclic, directory and administrative links
Author-test overlay through linked leaf or parent
Candidate targeting a link or canonical protected alias target
Missing executable or incorrectly imported original source
Changed, missing, skipped, xfailed or deselected protected assertions
Forged, resealed or replayed collection and receipt evidence
Wrong scope, stale executable or plugin identity and unauthorized plugin replacement
freeze_order: Commit this protocol and executable acceptance tests before implementation
Commit all execution authority before qualification
Independently inspect retained native evidence and exact source before new frontier metadata queries
audit: Retain raw common/current/linked Git-index bytes before the first Git read in each audited interval; record differences without restoration.
diagnostic_only: Every previously exposed V3, V4 and V41 repository/task is excluded from prospective claims. A screening refusal is retained and charged, never outcome-selected away.
